item.title: Second-half Paynt Points Payouts for 2025 are Heading Out
item.description: By Jessica Hein, PHJ News: Paynt Points payouts for 2025 points earned in the second half of the year are heading out to exhibitors in mid-February. Once again, the fledgling program exceeded expectations with payouts of $11.35 per point.
